title: BeSpec: Behavior-Level Specification Alignment for Code Generation
abstract: arXiv:2607.02949v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have advanced code generation from natural language descriptions of desired behavior (intent). Most existing methods refine code using execution feedback while leaving the underlying specification unchanged, implicitly assuming that the LLM correctly understands the intent. Yet ambiguous or underspecified descriptions can lead even capable models to correctly implement the wrong intent, making specification mismatch a central bottleneck.   This paper presents BeSpec, a behavioral model based approach to specification alignment. Treating intent as partial evidence of intended program behavior, BeSpec extracts a structured specification and predicts executable behaviors that capture properties a correct program should satisfy. translated_title: BeSpec：面向代码生成的行为级规格对齐
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已经推动了从自然语言描述（即意图）生成代码的进展。现有大多数方法利用执行反馈来改进代码，同时保持底层规格说明不变，隐含地假设LLM正确理解了意图。然而，模糊或不完整的描述可能导致即使是能力很强的模型也“正确地”实现了错误的意图，这使得规格不匹配成为核心瓶颈。本文提出了BeSpec，一种基于行为模型的规格对齐方法。BeSpec将意图视为预期程序行为的部分证据，从中提取结构化的规格说明，并预测可执行的行为，以刻画正确程序应满足的属性。这种方式避免了需要精确的测试预言（test oracles），因为预测精确测试预言的难度可能与求解问题本身相当。BeSpec在探针输入上执行候选程序并比较其观测到的行为……
tldr: 本文提出BeSpec，一种基于行为模型的规格对齐方法，通过提取结构化规格并预测可执行行为来检测意图与实现之间的不匹配，解决了LLM代码生成中因规格不匹配而错误实现意图的核心瓶颈。
en_tdlr: BeSpec is a behavioral model-based approach that aligns specifications by extracting structured specifications and predicting executable behaviors, tackling specification mismatch—the central bottleneck where LLMs correctly implement the wrong intent in code generation.
